description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class 'AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI' within the 'OrangeHRM\Attendance\Api' namespace. It provides a method 'getOne' to check for overlapping punch-out records based on provided query parameters. The class extends another class to inherit behavior related to attendance punch-in records and incorporates documentation annotations for API specification.

classes.name: AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API class for checking punch-out record overlaps in employee attendance tracking. Extends 'AttendancePunchInRecordOverlapAPI', providing a specific endpoint for punch-out overlap validation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to verify if a punch-out overlaps with existing records. Retrieves query parameters, computes the UTC punch-out time, checks for overlaps via attendance service, and returns the result. Catches and rethrows exceptions as HTTP 400 responses.
